scope: Original kit-specific Stat Focus A/B desk research. Each entry compares an existing source-linked community starting choice with an alternative at equal resources; no gameplay measurements, rights clearance or best-in-slot claim.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Sasquatch, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Use third-light finishers to build Rage and medium hits for Ruptures. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Do not mistake a changed direct hit for proof of longer resource uptime or stronger debuff ticks.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Sasquatch on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Enervate and Exhaustion prevent Rage; regeneration reversal removes recovery effects. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Original dated kit-aware editorial comparison; based on the cited champion rotation and Kabam Stat Focus design, not independent combat tests. Existing community setting remains a hypothesis; Critical Rating versus Critical Damage Rating and Armor Penetration versus Block Proficiency are falsifiable alternatives.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Shathra, Block Proficiency is a survival experiment for the blocking required by the setup, not a direct offensive damage multiplier. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Use basic attacks and Special 1 to build Eggs and establish Atrophy. Compare Physical Resistance against the same opponent, rank and resources. Block Proficiency is an indirect survival choice while building Eggs and Wasps, not a stronger Wasp damage multiplier.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Shathra on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Heavy charging needs a safe window and available enemy power; fourth lights spend Wasps for Nullify. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.

Keep the source-linked setup constant: Use second-medium attacks in Absorb to apply Coldsnap and build Core Charge. Compare Critical Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Armor Penetration should not be credited with higher Coldsnap ticks or the energy conversions of Core Charge without an explicit mechanic.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Solvarch on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Armor Break removes passive armor; Special 3 empties Core Charge and returns to Absorb. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
